title: Forgetting the native restriction/tensor comparison
statement: Fix the finite field k₀, coefficient prime l, and separated finite-type schemes U,Z with an open immersion j:U→Z over k₀. Let s be the native open sheaf data, rho the derived native restriction/tensor isomorphism, and c a presentation [def-sf-native-open-tensor-presentation-data] whose restriction, sheaf tensors, total tensors, derived tensors, K-flat predicates, models and summand insertions are the specified native ones. The equalities do not constrain c.E or c.gamma. There exists a natural ordinary restriction/tensor isomorphism rho′: TB′⋙R′ ≅ (R′×R′)⋙TA′ for the fixed ordinary tensor models [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful]. For every pair M,N of native ambient derived objects, FA(rho(M,N)) followed by the fixed open tensor comparison and the two forget/restriction comparisons equals the forget/restriction comparison followed by R′ of the ambient tensor comparison and rho′(FB M,FB N). No open tensor isomorphism gamma′, inverse-unit identity or gamma forgetting square is asserted.

proof.text: Use the balanced ordinary restriction/tensor isomorphism on the geometric open; it sends tensor generators to their restrictions. The localized coefficient map is invertible. The same construction on direct-sum total complexes commutes with both signed differentials.

proof.text: Use exact restriction, K-flat resolutions and the fixed ordinary tensor models to descend this comparison to rho′. Forgetting the native representatives gives the same resolutions, and s.restriction_forget identifies the degreewise maps.

The presentation restriction_summands identifies the total maps summand by summand; restriction_model then identifies the localization factorizations with rho. The two-variable localization universal property extends their equality to all derived pairs. The compositors of the exact functors are exactly the prescribed forget/restriction comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem native_open_tensor_restriction_forget (s : NativeOpenTensorData k₀ l j)
    (rho : nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l Z ⋙ nativeOpenPull k₀ l j ≅
      (nativeOpenPull k₀ l j).prod (nativeOpenPull k₀ l j) ⋙ nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l U)
    (c : OpenTensorPresentation (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l U) (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l Z))
    (_hc :
      HEq c.R (upperStar k₀ l j) ∧
      HEq c.SA (nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.SB (nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.TA (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.TB (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.DA (nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.DB (nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.flatA (NativeIsKFlat k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.flatB (NativeIsKFlat k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.modelA (nativeOpenTensorModel k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.modelB (nativeOpenTensorModel k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.iA (nativeOpenTensorInsertion k₀ l U) ∧ HEq c.iB (nativeOpenTensorInsertion k₀ l Z) ∧
      HEq c.sheafRestriction s.sheafRestriction ∧ HEq c.restriction rho) :
    ∃ rho' :
      (nativeDerivedClosedComparison k₀ l Z).ordinaryClosed.tensor ⋙
          (ProEtale.adicUpperStar l
            (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).mapDerivedCategory ≅
        ((ProEtale.adicUpperStar l
          (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).mapDerivedCategory).prod
          ((ProEtale.adicUpperStar l
            (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).mapDerivedCategory) ⋙
              (nativeDerivedClosedComparison k₀ l U).ordinaryClosed.tensor,
      ∀ M N,
        (nativeForget k₀ l U).map (rho.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
          (nativeDerivedClosedComparison k₀ l U).tensorComparison.hom.app
            ((nativeOpenPull k₀ l j).obj M, (nativeOpenPull k₀ l j).obj N) ≫
          (nativeDerivedClosedComparison k₀ l U).ordinaryClosed.tensor.map
            (Prod.mkHom ((nativeOpenForgetPull k₀ l j).hom.app M)
              ((nativeOpenForgetPull k₀ l j).hom.app N)) =
        (nativeOpenForgetPull k₀ l j).hom.app ((nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l Z).obj (M, N)) ≫
          (ProEtale.adicUpperStar l
            (Scheme.Hom.geometricFiberMap j (comp_over j _))).mapDerivedCategory.map
              ((nativeDerivedClosedComparison k₀ l Z).tensorComparison.hom.app (M, N)) ≫
          rho'.hom.app ((nativeForget k₀ l Z).obj M, (nativeForget k₀ l Z).obj N)
